title: Spine CT scan
what: Cross-section images of your vertebrae. They show bones best: fractures, a narrowed spinal canal, and bone spurs.
why: After a back injury, for pain, if MRI is not possible, before surgery, and to check after it.
duration: usually 10 to 15 minutes in the room; the report the same day or in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: If you are or might be pregnant
If CT with contrast is ordered: any allergy to iodine or contrast dye, and kidney disease
If you have metal hardware in your spine
If it is hard to lie on your back because of pain

prepare.title: Without contrast
prepare.text: No prep needed. You can eat and drink.

prepare.title: With contrast
prepare.text: Usually no food for 3 to 4 hours. Water is fine. Sometimes a creatinine blood test is needed. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: No metal in the scan area: zippers, clasps, or belts.

bring: Past CT and MRI scans of the spine
Painkillers your doctor prescribed, if the pain is strong
steps: You lie on the table, and the technician helps you get comfortable
The table moves into the wide ring of the scanner
Keep still, and sometimes hold your breath on command
If contrast is used, it goes into a vein and more images are taken
feel: It does not hurt. The scanner hums quietly
The ring is wide, so it does not feel cramped
With contrast: a wave of warmth and a metallic taste. It passes in a minute
after: You can go back to your day right away
After contrast, drink more water, unless your doctor said otherwise
Take the report to a neurologist or spine surgeon
red_flags: Numbness between the legs, trouble peeing, or sudden weakness in the legs: call emergency services right away
After contrast: itching, a rash, a swollen face, or trouble breathing. Tell the staff right away or call emergency services

faq.q: Which is better for a herniated disc, CT or MRI?
faq.a: Discs and nerves are seen better on MRI. CT shows bones better. Your doctor chooses.

faq.q: Can I have a spine CT with metal in my back?
faq.a: Yes. Metal does not rule out CT, but it may slightly affect the images.

reminders.text: Spine CT soon. If contrast is used, do not eat for 3 to 4 hours. Water is fine.
